hook: Helium prices exploded 4x once, and your phone's chips need it.
closing: Once helium escapes, it leaves Earth for good.
question: Would you give up party balloons?

segments.say: Qatar holds the most helium, 10.1 billion cubic meters, then the United States.
Demand is set to grow 90% by 2035 as chip factories need more.
In the last crunch, from 2011 to 2013, helium prices quadrupled.

title: Helium Prices Went Up 4x Before. It's Happening Again.
